No server, no ops, no public URL."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**What it replaces** — the loop of *open the IDE → describe the task → watch it edit → switch back t"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"o chat to report*. That loop becomes one sentence in Feishu."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Why not another bridge** — most Feishu-agent bridges hand you a bot that answers messages. This ha"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"nds you an agent with a terminal, approval gates and session memory — and it shares the same session"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" library as your DSH Desktop, so work begun in the chat is still there when you open the desktop app"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"library as your DSH Desktop, so work begun in the chat is still there when you open the desktop app."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 🧭 How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **In** — the message arrives over a WebSocket long connection. No callback URL, no reverse proxy, "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"no public IP.
- **Through** — the bridge maps each chat (DM or group) to its own `dsh` agent, which "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"reads and writes your real working directory.
- **Back** — thinking, approval requests and results r"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"eturn to the chat as native Feishu messages.
- **Shared** — the `web` and `desktop` runtime forms sh"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"are one `~/.dsh` session library."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A cloud ledger keyed per endpoint (`deviceId` + `form` + `profile`) keeps one instance per endpoint "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"answering and elects a successor when the active one goes quiet. Both forms read and write the same "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"sessions, so failing over never loses the conversation."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## ✨ Three things most bridges don't do"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Runs on your machine, in minutes, with no public address"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"One `pnpm dlx` command installs the plugin and boots the host; a QR code is the whole credential flo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"w. The transport is an outbound WebSocket long connection — nothing has to reach you from the intern"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"The transport is an outbound WebSocket long connection — nothing has to reach you from the internet."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### You can see what it's thinking"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Reasoning renders as Feishu's own *thinking* message. Tool calls arrive with their icon and the firs"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t lines of their result; the full output stays in the session log. Every turn closes with one plain "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"line — how many tool calls it made, how long it took. Nothing has to be taken on faith."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### A long task is not "fire and forget""},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Send a message while a turn is running and it follows `busyPolicy`: `queue` waits its turn, `steer` "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"takes over at the next step boundary **without discarding work already done**, `inject` adds context"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" without waking the driver. Risky operations become approval cards. Turn on `autoResumeGoals` and a "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"goal picks itself back up after a restart."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🚀 Quick Start"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"**Prerequisites:** Node 22.19+ or 24+, pnpm, a DeepSeek API key, Feishu on your phone.
**Harness:** "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"dsh `>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh` in `package.json`)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Two traps, both real:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Use `pnpm`, not `npx`.** On one machine this was recorded at about 20 seconds versus about 25 mi"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"nutes (npm's serial reify), and on a ≤4 GB machine the npm process died with "JavaScript heap out of"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" memory" mid-install. Those are the author's numbers, not a benchmark this repository reproduces — t"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"reat the gap as *large*, not as *exactly 20 vs 25*.
- **Do not `npm i -g dsh-lark-bridge`.** That na"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"me on npm belongs to an unrelated project. This one is **`@moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge`**."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"First install fails on protobufjs? — two-minute fix"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"pnpm 10 blocks dependency build scripts by default and exits non-zero with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`"},{"id":"p27s2","text":". The blocked script belongs to `protobufjs` (a Feishu SDK dependency); it only prints a version-sch"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"eme warning — no file written, no network."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Open `<your-home>/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` and set `protobufjs: false` under `allowBui"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"lds`. After the failed install pnpm writes the literal text `set this to true or false` there — repl"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ace it with `false`. Then **re-run the same command**: a failed install leaves the profile half-conf"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"igured (bundles are not merged when the install exits non-zero), so editing the file alone does not "},{"id":"p28s5","text":" are not merged when the install exits non-zero), so editing the file alone does not finish the job."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"`allowBuilds` (pnpm 10.26+) is the only key pnpm reads for this; `onlyBuiltDependencies` and the oth"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"er legacy keys were removed in pnpm 11."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 🎯 Three commands to try first"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Command | What you get |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| `/manual` | The full eight-section user guide, delivered in the chat |
